public_entry_points.output: verify returns only an opaque, non-copyable/non-serializable verified-chain value with deployment_eligible exactly false. It exposes no raw authority, lifecycle handle, capture method, session, admission-consumed state, or callable effect route. Constructor and verify return no lifecycle object on either success or refusal.

verification_request.input_type: exact built-in bytes only; dict, str, bytearray, bytes subclass, decoded JSON, iterable of objects, and pre-indexed resolver values refuse
verification_request.canonical_encoding: UTF-8, ASCII-only canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, finite numbers, duplicate-key refusal, and byte-for-byte canonical re-encoding equality. Every artifact payload is exact canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes encoded as unpadded base64url; decoding and re-encoding must be identical.
verification_request.target: Exactly one {schema,sha256} target. profile is exactly action-execution-admission or final-replay-admission and must agree with the target schema.
verification_request.artifact_item: Exactly {schema,sha256,canonical_json_b64}; items sort by (schema,sha256), are unique by that pair and by sha256, and sha256 is the named self-digest of the decoded object. No item is a supplied parsed object or a URL/path/resolver handle.
verification_request.exact_closure_rule: After parsing the target, the artifact set must equal—not merely contain—the transitive closure of all artifact identities named by every validated application field and every IssuanceBasisRef reachable from the target. Each named identity resolves to exactly one supplied item with the expected schema, kind, role, and canonical self-digest. A missing target, duplicate, unreachable extra, unknown schema, unrecognized reference form, cycle, self-reference, future-output reference, or unresolved hash refuses. A syntactically lower-case hash is never described as verified until this resolution and its target validation finish.
verification_request.external_dependency_rule: A closure edge whose schema is outside the pinned registry is not an opaque success: verify refuses as unsupported-external-schema. It may be admitted only after a later approved registry entry supplies that exact schema, canonical validator, issuer/key-use rule, and dependency blob pin. revocation_snapshot_sha256 is the sole exception: it is a trusted revocation-seam lookup identifier, not an artifact closure claim.

action-execution-admission: The exact HistoricalStudyStageAdmission.v1 tuple, ScopeAuthorization.v2, ScopeIntent.v1, ActionIntent.v1, ActionIntentSet.v1, ReplayIntentSet.v1, all complete G0--G7 GateEvidenceRef.v1 values, gate-set inputs, and all their issuance bases and referenced closure.

Every bootstrap PEA/CES/BVP/CaptureAdmissionSet tuple required by ScopeAuthorization, its ExecutionDocumentContract.v1, PlannedCaptureSet.v1, every PlannedCaptureEntry.v1, the exact PIS and every referenced root publication authorization/receipt/PIS entry, plus every issuance basis and recursively referenced object.

For the target stage, the exact PEA/CES/BVP/CaptureAdmissionSet/PlannedCaptureSet/PCE tuple, ExecutionDocumentContract, PIS, and all predecessor StageAdmission/ActionExecutionAdmission/publication-receipt/PIS objects named by it, with every issuance basis/ref closure.
final-replay-admission: The exact HistoricalStudyManifest.v2, both FinalReplayEntry.v1 values, both ReplayIntent.v1 values and ReplayIntentSet.v1, the full ScopeAuthorization/ScopeIntent/action-intent/gate closure, and every issuance basis/ref closure.

Every stage admission, action execution admission, stage publication receipt/output, release output, PIS and predecessor artifact that the Final Manifest validates, including all complete root bootstrap tuples.

For each of the two pre-final replay entries, its exact replay PIS/CES/PEA/BVP/CaptureAdmissionSet/PlannedCaptureSet/PCE/ExecutionDocumentContract tuple, each named published receipt, and all issuance bases/ref closure.
required_artifact_profiles.excluded_from_both: CapturedPortAuthorization.v2, LifecycleCapturedReceipt.v2, CapturedAuthorizationSet.v2, ReplayCaptureAdmissionEvidence.v1, LaunchSession, live ports, frozen documents, published handles, member handles, runtime measurements, and all mutable/WORM consumption state are not valid request artifacts or outputs in Packet 3.

trusted_seams.keyring: Injected instance of dskit.pipeline.trust.ReleaseKeyring only. After local closure, schema, key-shape, issuer/key-use, and signature_alg == Ed25519 checks, it is called exactly as verify(key_id, key_version, issued_at_ms, canonical_preimage_bytes, signature). True of exact bool type is required; False, a non-bool, or a raise refuses. The configured keyring is the trusted source for the (key_id,key_version,issued_at_ms) Ed25519 public-key selection; Packet 3 has no signing key, algorithm fallback, key fallback, or caller key material.
trusted_seams.clock: Injected instance of dskit.pipeline.trust.TrustedClock only. now_ms() must return a non-bool int and is read for validation; caller timestamps never substitute for it. not_before_ms <= issued_at_ms <= expires_at_ms and not_before_ms <= now_ms <= expires_at_ms are mandatory; a clock error or invalid result refuses.
trusted_seams.revocations: Injected HistoricalStudyRevocations with exactly is_unrevoked(revocation_snapshot_sha256, key_id, key_version, now_ms) -> bool. The snapshot id must be a lower-case SHA-256 token already present in each signed envelope, but its source/content is asserted only by this trusted seam, not by a dangling artifact claim. Exact bool True is required independently for every signed artifact at the same trusted now_ms; False, non-bool, unknown snapshot/key/version, or a raise refuses.
trusted_seams.schema_registry: A static, code-pinned registry of the exact closed schemas named in required_artifact_profiles. It maps each schema to one default-deny parser, named self-digest field, issuer/key-use rule where signed, and permitted reference grammar. It has no dynamic import, URL, file, plugin, registry lookup, provider open, or application-data read.

verified_invariants.canonical_and_envelope: For every supplied artifact that the profile reaches: canonical bytes, complete/default-deny key closure (including nested key, subject_ref, authority_ref, execution_authority_ref, entry, PIS projection, PCE, receipt, stage, final, and basis/ref shapes), named self-digest, exact Ed25519 preimage, signature, issuer role, exclusive key use, key id/version, time, and revocation all verify or the request refuses.
verified_invariants.transitive_links: For every reached link: IssuanceBasis kind/ref set; PIS entry/receipt projection; CES-to-PCE conversion; PlannedCaptureSet/PCE cardinality/order/digest; P(CES)==P(BVP)==P(CAS), and the applicable StageAdmission or FinalReplayEntry/Manifest equality and chronology are checked only from the supplied exact closure. The verifier makes no assertion about a link outside that closure.
verified_invariants.chronology: The complete selected profile must satisfy the ADR ordering and all predecessor/future-output prohibitions, including ScopeIntent <= CES <= PEA <= BVP <= CAS <= target admission, action predecessor publication order, and final-manifest-before-final-replay-admission. Equality is byte equality of canonical projections, never equal-looking decoded values.
verified_invariants.failure: Any failure returns no chain/value and leaves deployment_eligible false. It performs no cache/store write, network call, member/provider open, import, node construction, execution-root creation, output creation, capture, session, admission consumption, or authority mutation.

deferred_effect_gates.packet_6: Descriptor/receipt equality, runtime/session/restart linkage, and binding of an authorized canonical chain to the actual frozen document, port, published handle, and receipt are later capture-boundary work; Packet 3 has no effect boundary.
deferred_effect_gates.packet_8: Durable atomic consumption of ActionExecutionAdmission or FinalReplayAdmission before any port/session is later authority work. F5A-R23-ctor-intern-unspend remains open and is neither represented by a boolean field nor weakened by this packet.
